# FLX-2123: a committed run directory holds a file the run does not account for

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim ship` packs the whole run directory, and `fluxsim verify` reads the emit streams in it, so every file there has to be one the run itself wrote: the files `apply`, `ship` and `calibrate --write` write, the shares `apply --shard` writes, and, for each emit the receipt names, its stream, seam attestation, fidelity input and fidelity record. A stream file for an emit the receipt does not name (an extra `emits/<id>.ndjson`, for example), or any other file or directory the engine never writes there, was added after `apply` and is not covered by the run digest, so a pack would carry it as if the run had produced it. The refusal names the first such file, as a path relative to the run directory. Remove the file, or move it out of the run directory.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2123
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
